meta.notes: day_start is the only field left here: the old floor/max_effect_at/curve/penalty_two_plus_items keys described the sim's own invented linear Bernoulli ramp and found>=2 penalty, both replaced by item_ladder below (owner ruling, docs/open_tasks.md decisions log 2026-08-13). rabbits_foot_bonus is unused by code -- the live Rabbit's Foot/Lucky Purse amount is special_items.json's own luck_bonus effect param.

The published item-count ladder ("Luck effects" DataMinedBox), replacing engine/items.py's old linear ramp. Effective luck = state.luck + per-draft modifiers (special_items.luck_bonus) - state.luck_penalty (owner-ruled per-day accumulator; wiki never states its reset scope). bands[].kind: 'flat' (a flat 1-item chance), 'chain' (5-10 luck: first-match ordered list, order is load-bearing), 'variable_mix' (a variable/1-item/0-item three-way split), 'always_variable' (100% variable), 'fixed' (a deterministic item count + Luck Penalty delta). The 'chain' row with if='day1_veteran_by_fast_early_drafts' can never match in this sim: GameConfig.veteran_mode (config.py) is a plain bool with no notion of Veteran Mode having been enabled MID-RUN by fast early drafts, so that branch always falls through to the next row (see docs/open_tasks.md decisions log 2026-08-13 and the PR-A report).

main_course_cycle indexed by day % 5: index 0 = pizza (day%5==0), index 1 = salmon (day%5==1), etc. fruit_weights ordering (apple > banana > orange) is sourced from the wiki's Pantry description; the exact weight values are not published and are inferred.

item_values.comment: Relative resource values used by shaped rewards and greedy policies; not game data.

meta.notes: Reward-shaping worth of a held special item, keyed by its Trading Post tier (untradeable items use the flat value). Calibrated near typical purchase prices so a fair buy is roughly reward-neutral; tunable knobs for retraining experiments, not game data.
